europe_now.title: Deadly High-Speed Train Collision in Spain
europe_now.summary: At least 68 people have been killed following a catastrophic collision involving two high-speed trains in Spain. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has vowed a full investigation, noting that it is unacceptable for the country to experience two such major accidents within a single year.
